name: basic-3d
label: Incanto 3D Empty Stage Template
description: Incanto engine 3D empty stage (Three.js underneath, the whole game is scene JSON): a solid ground under a physical sky, a shadow-casting sun, a marker cube and a camera framing the origin — no character. Pick this for a 3D game that is not a character game: puzzle, board game, tower defense, idle, tycoon, simulation, sandbox. The project uses the incanto-* skills — read incanto-your-first-game before the first edit. 3D only; not for 2D games.

name: basic-3d-r3f-empty
label: R3F 3D Empty Stage Template
description: React Three Fiber 9 / three / drei 3D empty stage: a ground under a sky, a shadow-casting sun, a clickable grid with a marker cube on the origin and an orbit camera — no character. Dynamic bodies (balls, crates, anything that rolls or tips over) go through @react-three/rapier, loaded lazily so it stays out of the first load. Pick this for a 3D game that is not a character game: puzzle, board game, tower defense, idle, tycoon, simulation, sandbox. 3D only; not for 2D games.

name: basic-3d-r3f-freeview
label: R3F 3D Character Freeview Template
description: React Three Fiber 9 / three / drei 3D third-person free-view character template: an animated character on an empty stage (floor, sky, sun) ready for boxes, ramps and height-field terrain, WASD relative to an orbiting camera (drag to look, wheel to zoom), run, jump with coyote time, touch joystick. The player is the template's own tested kinematic controller; dynamic bodies go through @react-three/rapier, loaded lazily so it stays out of the first load. Pick this for a 3D exploration, action or RPG game seen from behind the character with a free camera. 3D only; not for 2D games.

label: R3F 3D First Person View (FPS) Template
description: React Three Fiber 9 / three / drei 3D first-person (FPS) template: the camera is the eye, pointer-lock mouse look (drag fallback, touch drag), WASD relative to where you face, run, jump, a crosshair, an empty stage (floor, sky, sun) ready for boxes, ramps and height-field terrain, touch joystick. The player is the template's own tested kinematic controller; dynamic bodies go through @react-three/rapier, loaded lazily so it stays out of the first load. name: basic-3d-r3f-flightview
label: R3F 3D Airplane Flightview Template
description: React Three Fiber 9 / three / drei 3D flight template: a kinematic airplane (tested pure flight step, no physics body) on a runway over grass and sea, throttle, pitch, roll and yaw, a banking chase camera, tracer bullets, seeded instanced scenery on the ground and in the sky, a speed / altitude HUD, touch joystick with throttle and fire buttons. The plane is built from primitives, ready to swap for a model. Dynamic bodies go through @react-three/rapier, loaded lazily so it stays out of the first load. Pick this for a 3D flight, airplane, dogfight or aerial game. 3D only; not for 2D games.

name: basic-3d-r3f-minecraft
label: R3F 3D Voxel Minecraft Template
description: React Three Fiber 9 / three / drei 3D voxel template: a seeded 80×80 block world (grass, dirt, stone) in 10×10 chunks, only exposed faces meshed and only chunks near the player drawn, an edit rebuilds only the chunks it touches; an animated character on the template's own tested kinematic controller (a 1-block step needs a jump), third-person orbit camera, crosshair raycast to mine (click) and place (right-click) blocks, touch joystick with MINE / PLACE / JUMP buttons. Dynamic bodies go through @react-three/rapier, loaded lazily so it stays out of the first load. Pick this for a 3D voxel, block-building, Minecraft-like or sandbox-crafting game. 3D only; not for 2D games.
